resumen: Up to about 10 people, in person, remote or mixed. Little setup: it just has to work and get recorded.
Board, team or committee with some people in the room and some remote; presentations and documents.
Committee of a deliberative body: agenda, files, committee reports, orderly turns to speak.
City council, board or chamber: seats, microphone central unit, the floor, quorum and roll-call vote.

titulo: Large assembly with voting and quorum
resumen: Large in-person assembly: check-in at the door, quorum, votes and results on screen.
Assembly or session with quorum and voting where some members take part remotely.
Owners or members, in person and by video call, voting by majority or percentage.
Teacher with students in the classroom and remote; materials, attendance at hand, questions, maybe translation.

titulo: Conference or talk with an audience
resumen: One or more speakers, audience in the room and online, questions, streaming.
Moderator and several panelists (in person or remote), turns and questions.
One or two hosts with guests, careful audio, video for social media.
Online presentation with registrants, questions, polls and downloadable material.
Game on screen, streamer camera, audience chat on screen, alerts.
School ceremony, graduation, anniversary: anthem, flags, crest, speeches and names.
Mass, service, wedding or celebration: music, lyrics on screen, readings, streaming.
Registered residents who speak in turns with a fixed time; speaker registration and minutes.
Launch of a product, book or project: video, presentation, guests and press.
Match or tournament: scoreboard, clock, commentary, replays and sponsors.
TVs at the venue, printed or on-screen QR codes, signage that changes during the event.
